original.value: A premium eco-conscious fashion advertisement, shot as a refined editorial product photo. A single off-white or natural cream crew-neck T-shirt hangs on a smooth wooden hanger with a black metal hook, placed against a lush wall of dense green leaves and climbing vines. The hanger has a small minimalist brand monogram engraved near the neck. The shirt is shown from the upper torso down to part of the hem, slightly angled, with soft natural folds and high-quality cotton texture. Printed inside the collar is a minimalist brand mark and the text "JUGGERKNOT ORIGINALS". Hanging from the neckline is 1 rectangular recycled-paper seed tag tied with rustic brown twine; the tag reads "Tulsi" and "Plantable Seed Tag" with a tiny sprouting seed detail near the bottom. From the tag, 1 real tulsi plant stem grows upward across the front of the shirt, with several fresh green leaves, visually demonstrating that the tag is plantable. Add a small fine-label annotation near the tag reading "TULSI PLANTABLE SEED TAG". On the right side, large elegant white serif typography says {argument name="headline text" default="Plant it."}. Beneath it, place 3 stacked lines of narrow uppercase sans-serif copy: "WEAR IT.", "PLANT IT.", and "GROW WITH IT.". At the lower left, add the brand name in spaced uppercase serif text: {argument name="brand name" default="JUGGERKNOT ORIGINALS"}, with a thin horizontal line above it. At the lower right, add 3 lines of small uppercase sans-serif text: "FSC® CERTIFIED PACKAGING.", "ZERO SYNTHETIC FIBRE", and "BACKED BY ZERODHA.". Use soft diffused daylight, shallow depth of field, moody green-and-cream color grading, luxury sustainable-brand aesthetics, clean composition, vertical poster layout, subtle shadows, and a calm organic atmosphere. Keep the design minimal, premium, and photorealistic, with the shirt occupying the left half and the typography balanced on the right.

zh-CN.value: 高端环保时尚广告，以精致的编辑产品照片拍摄。一件米白色或天然奶油色圆领T恤挂在光滑的木质衣架上，衣架配有黑色金属钩，背景是茂密的绿色植物墙和攀缘植物。衣架在颈部附近有一个简约的品牌字母组合雕刻。T恤从上半身展示到部分下摆，略微倾斜，带有自然的柔软褶皱和高品质棉质纹理。领口内侧印有简约的品牌标志和文字"JUGGERKNOT ORIGINALS"。从领口悬挂着一个矩形再生纸种子标签，用质朴的棕色麻绳系着；标签上写着"罗勒"和"可种植种子标签"，底部附近有一个微小的发芽种子细节。从标签上，一株真实的罗勒植物茎向上生长穿过衬衫前面，有几片新鲜的绿叶，直观地展示了标签的可种植性。在标签附近添加一个小型精致标签注释，写着"罗勒可种植种子标签"。右侧，大型优雅的白色衬线字体写着{argument name="headline text" default="Plant it."}。在其下方，放置三行窄大写无衬线文字："穿上它。"，"种植它。"，"与它一起成长。"。在左下方，添加间隔大写的衬线文字品牌名称：{argument name="brand name" default="JUGGERKNOT ORIGINALS"}，上方有一条细水平线。在右下方，添加三行小写无衬线文字："FSC®认证包装。"，"零合成纤维"，"由ZERODHA支持。"。使用柔和的漫射日光，浅景深，情绪化的绿色和奶油色调，奢华可持续品牌美学，简洁构图，垂直海报布局，微妙阴影，以及平静有机的氛围。保持设计简约、高端和逼真，衬衫占据左半部分，文字平衡在右侧。
